sources.note: Non-commercial last-resort source, used for the typical wild lifespan (3 to 5 years, Lifespan/Longevity section), the breeding months and corroboration of diurnal activity. No permissive source gave a typical lifespan; AmphiBIO Longevity_max_y is a maximum and was not used.

human_tolerance.notes: Forest, bog and woodland breeder. No source checked gives urban tolerance; Avoider is a judgement.

phases.name: dormancy
phases.note: Overwinters in upland leaf litter and soil near breeding pools; northern populations freeze. Dates are an authored approximation for the northern US and Canada; southern populations are less dormant.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: ADW: breeds March to May. Wikipedia: explosive breeder right after snowmelt.

vocalizations.description: Males chorus at breeding pools with a duck-like quacking call, mainly during the spring breeding period.

taxonomy.note: GBIF species match 2026-10-31: usageKey 2427072, rank SPECIES, ACCEPTED, EXACT.

external.note: iNaturalist taxon 66012 (Lithobates sylvaticus, active species) is the taxon_id in the iNaturalist activity queries.

range.note: Wikipedia Geographic range: contiguous range from northern Georgia and northeastern Canada across Canada to Alaska; US and CA listed as native. No introduced range stated.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Wikipedia: walks, jumps and swims at breeding pools; the mode list is a judgement from that description.

traits.respiration.note: judgement: Lungs is the standard anuran class; no source field checked.

traits.nest_type.note: Eggs laid attached to submerged substrate; no nest.

traits.mass_kg.note: AmphiBIO Body_mass_g 17.6 converted g to kg. AmphiBIO v1 does not state sex or age of the value.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of Wikipedia 51 to 70 mm (60.5 mm, rounded to 0.06 m). Wikipedia does not say snout-vent, so this is an approximate body length. ADW (NC) gives 3.5 to 7.6 cm and AmphiBIO Body_size_mm is 83; the sources disagree.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Midpoint of ADW Typical lifespan, wild, 3 to 5 years (4.0). ADW gives 4 to 5 years (Quebec, southern Illinois) and 3 to 4 years (several other states) as regional inputs. Not a maximum: AmphiBIO Longevity_max_y 5.2 was not used. Last-resort NC source; no permissive typical-lifespan source found.

traits.diet.note: Wikipedia: diet primarily insects and small forest-floor invertebrates; AmphiBIO Arthro=1, Vert=NA. 1.0 invertebrate is a judgement.

traits.social.note: judgement: mostly solitary outside breeding choruses. Not sourced from the NC ADW account.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Wikipedia: mostly diurnal and rarely seen at night except maybe in breeding choruses. The ADW account (NC) says diurnal too, but it is not needed for this datum. AmphiBIO Diu/Noc/Crepu are NA.

traits.defense.note: Wikipedia describes camouflage on the forest floor. Hide is a judgement.

habitat.use.note: Judgement from Wikipedia: spends most time on the forest floor, nonarboreal; breeds in ephemeral pools.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Hibernacula in upper organic soil layers under leaf litter.

habitat.resources.note: Invertebrate food; ephemeral pools for breeding; leaf litter for overwintering; water.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: judgement: forest and bog breeder; no urban source checked.

seasonal.strategy.note: Overwinters in upland soil and leaf litter; Wikipedia describes freezing during hibernation.

seasonal.triggers.note: judgement: authored simulation thresholds, not from a wood frog source.

seasonal.phases.note: Breeding March to May from ADW (NC) and Wikipedia early-spring breeding; dormancy 11-01 to 02-28 is an authored approximation for northern populations.

seasonal.life_stages.note: judgement: stage order (egg, tadpole, juvenile, adult) and scale values are authored.

activity.US.note: Observation-based curve from iNaturalist place 1 (United States) and GBIF country US; see the query fields.

vocalizations.chorus.note: Wikipedia: males chorus with duck-like quacking at pools. Breeding months March to May from ADW (NC; only source for the months). cooldown_s 10 and loudness Moderate are judgement.

look.note: judgement: palette and proportions authored for the preview.

behavior.note: Species-local program (behavior.json). Diurnal timing from Wikipedia (mostly diurnal, rarely seen at night except in breeding choruses) and ADW (diurnal; breeding March to May; the ADW source is NC and is used only for the month set). Chorus at dusk and night is an authored reading of "except maybe in breeding choruses". Temperature range 4 to 25 C, flee and freeze distances, hunger thresholds and dwell times are authored judgement. Gaits: walk for forage and wander, hop for flight.
